name: mmdagent-ex
description: Voice interaction platform with 3D CG characters
notes: On first launch, enter the event code you received to download the content.
The content is saved in the MMDAgent-Contents folder on your desktop. It is kept when you update.
About 700 MB of free disk space is needed.
A Meta Quest 3 version is also available. To join the release channel, see the Meta Quest 3 section of https://mmdagent-ex-doc.netlify.app/getting-started/install/
If Windows blocks a .dll file at startup (error 0xC0E90002), turn off Smart App Control: Windows Security > App & browser control > Smart App Control settings > Off, then start the app again.
